environment_validity.scope: geometry, reset, finite physical state and explicit simulation-domain failures; independent of task_success

qualification_semantics: Integrity acceptance is independent of task success; preserve authoritative record_valid/BC labels

original_final_result.acceptance_geometry_scope: Declared input material geometry checks plus actual physical contact and motion, not calibrated cooked geometry or real accuracy

grasp_relative_pose.anchor_reference: Configured body point[0,0,grasp_height] in hand frame, not measured contact pressure centre. Anchor metrics are analysis only; existing acceptance gates unchanged.
grasp_relative_pose.position_reference: Vessel bottom-frame origin in hand frame; includes rotation lever-arm motion, not isolated axial slip.

extraction.boundary_definition: Independent observed physical lift/source-clear/near-target events; teacher phase ignored

static_grasp.boundary_definition: Independent observed physical lift/source-clear/near-target events; teacher phase ignored

original_final_result.physics_trust_scope: declared input geometry and recorded physical state; effective cooked geometry and real calibration remain unverified
original_final_result.record_valid_scope: independent physical trace AND collector action/sensor/time integrity

before_first_target_support.interpretation: relative cup-in-hand motion; support-handover motion is not automatically grasp failure
before_first_target_support.interval_definition: reference_t <= sample_t < first support_transfer confirmation; if none, through operation_end_t
before_first_target_support.missing_sample_count_definition: observed rows lacking finite translation or rotation evidence; does not invent samples inside an evidence gap
before_first_target_support.sample_count_definition: completed physical rows observed in the declared interval
before_first_target_support.sampling_scope: physical samples after fixed attempt reference; not control-rate maxima

operation.interpretation: relative cup-in-hand motion; support-handover motion is not automatically grasp failure
operation.interval_definition: reference_t <= sample_t <= operation_end_t; entire operation, including support handover
operation.missing_sample_count_definition: observed rows lacking finite translation or rotation evidence; does not invent samples inside an evidence gap
operation.sample_count_definition: completed physical rows observed in the declared interval
operation.sampling_scope: physical samples after fixed attempt reference; not control-rate maxima

support_transfer.interpretation: relative cup-in-hand motion; support-handover motion is not automatically grasp failure
support_transfer.missing_sample_count_definition: observed rows lacking finite translation or rotation evidence; does not invent samples inside an evidence gap
support_transfer.sample_count_definition: completed physical rows observed in the declared interval
support_transfer.sampling_scope: physical samples after fixed attempt reference; not control-rate maxima

attempts.relative_motion_summary_semantics: entire operation from fixed reference through operation end; see named interval statistics

relative_pose_reference.source: first valid bilateral-hold reference in this attempt

events_replay.source: append-only Progress lifecycle events only; no summary or task-success input

progress.finalize_events_included: Consumed every line of progress_events.jsonl, including unassigned/finalize outcomes if emitted; no event required when no attempt exists
